skills.name: Simulated NSC Oral Examination
skills.description: Respond to an unseen question set in a simulated NSC oral examination by answering 4 questions demonstrating command word precision, formal register, and reasoning beyond factual recall (70-100 words each).
skills.questionFormat: AUTHOR: describe the answer expected (e.g. '1 sentence stating the central argument')
skills.defaultPrompt: AUTHOR: the question shown to the learner

recovery.action: COMMAND_PRECISION_LOW_ORAL: command word differentiation card — analyse/evaluate/discuss/compare with defining response characteristics; learner identifies which type is required before answering. skills.name: Critically Evaluate Own Argument Transcript
skills.description: Critically evaluate own spoken argument transcript at distinction level by identifying at least 2 register lapses, 2 structural gaps, and 2 reasoning failures, proposing a specific revision for each, and producing an overall self-assessment with at least 3 criterion-based reasons.
skills.questionFormat: AUTHOR: describe the answer expected (e.g. '1 sentence stating the central argument')
skills.defaultPrompt: AUTHOR: the question shown to the learner

recovery.action: SELF_EVAL_SURFACE_L14: 'Your evaluation only addresses surface features. Now evaluate the structure and logic of your argument.' Structural and reasoning checklists displayed; each category requires at least 1 identified issue. REVISION_TOO_SIMILAR: 'Your proposed revision is too similar to the original. Revise substantially.' Revision similarity check enforced before acceptance.
